description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/varcoeff_laplacian_lev_noflux_bc -- the conservative finite-volume variable-coefficient VERTICAL DIFFUSION operator d/dz(kz du/dz) on the non-uniform vertical, with zero-flux walls at both the surface and the model top (the Kzz / boundary-layer mixing operator of a chemical transport model). Pins that the rule's compound match D(kz * D(u,lev), lev) fires at priority 10 on the whole compound (rather than a plain-D rule lowering the inner derivative first) and that the three regions -- interior k in [2, NLEV-1], surface slab k = 1, model-top slab k = NLEV -- lower to the expected flux-difference structure, with each interior face flux written byte-identically in the two cells that share it (which is what makes the mass sum telescope). NLEV = 6 is the smallest grid exercising all three regions with a nonempty interior.
